cohort: The study included 192 preterm infants (26 to 38 gestational weeks, 500 to 3,500 grams) with moderate to severe respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) who were treated with the INSURE method.
finding: Higher severity of RDS and lower gestational age were identified as significant predictors of INSURE method failure in the treatment of RDS in preterm infants.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for infants born between July 2011 and April 2016.
